statement: tower-data's automated backups have never been restored: a restore that was never rehearsed may fail when it is needed.

treatment.plan: The restore was drilled on 2026-11-12 (docs/process/drills/2026-11-12-tower-data-restore.md); the risk's premise, that no restore had been rehearsed, was false. A drill every operation.restore_max_days (90) keeps DATA-tower-data protected; the next is due by 2027-02-10.
